records-for-updating-a-holding-and-termi.text: Records for updating a holding and terminating its key on the proved design.

Issue 743. This page names the new and changed records, their fields and the invariants each one must keep. Field encodings follow the aligned Lean models; where those models fix an order or a constructor number, that wins over this page. Records issue 742 introduced are in its data model and are not repeated.

life-of-a-key.text: A pending termination is not a Singular state: its leaf stays active until the fold. A terminal leaf has no transition.
